parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Gokana-street (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1420 | 1.44 | 1.44
2 | 859 | 1.49 | 2.93
3 | 987 | 14.5 | 17.4
4 | 2246 | 33.5 | 50.9
5 | 34337 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Gokana-street (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: HA-type
Aquifer depth: 17.4 – 50.9 m
Recommendation: Target the moderately resistive (2246 Ω·m) sandy layer between 17.4 m and 50.9 m as the main water-bearing zone; case off the upper clayey/silty layers (0–17.4 m) and place the screen within the 17.4–50.9 m interval, confirming lithology with cuttings before terminating drilling above the highly resistive basal layer (>34,000 Ω·m), which likely represents a dry or impervious formation.
